rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents in buildings of 5 or more units under its Rent Control Ordinance, administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt, and owners may request other permitted exemptions.
rules.key_value: Rent control for 5+ unit properties; 1-4 unit exempt
citation_aliases: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.effective_date_note: The page gives no adoption or effective date.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other exemptions via a Rent Control Exemption Request

unverifiable_exemptions: other exemptions under the Rent Control Ordinance require an owner exemption request

rules.review_note: The page does not state the cap formula or the effective date. The 30-year new-construction exemption comes from state N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.5 (context only).

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ban is enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services; fines up to $2,000/day
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.effective_date_note: Source says 'effective June 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43, eff. 7/1/2027) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect.
rules.review_note: Only secondary sources are available for this ordinance.

parsed.notes: Jersey City: the rent control (ch. 260) and algorithmic ban (§ 218-12) records are supported by the documents. No document covers the other four categories at city level, so no rules or no-rule findings were added for them.
